component.name: HEIC for Linux
component.summary: Dynamic Apple HEIC wallpapers with astronomical precision
Dynamische Apple HEIC-Hintergrundbilder mit astronomischer Präzision

description.p: HEIC for Linux brings macOS dynamic HEIC wallpapers to the Linux desktop. It reads the embedded Apple solar metadata from .heic files and calculates the exact sun elevation and azimuth for your postal code offline.

HEIC for Linux bringt dynamische macOS HEIC-Hintergrundbilder auf den Linux-Desktop. Es liest die eingebetteten Apple-Sonnenstandsdaten aus .heic-Dateien aus und berechnet Sonnenhöhe und Azimut für deine Postleitzahl komplett offline.

ul.li: Extracts frames and solar metadata from dynamic Apple HEIC files
Calculates local solar elevation and azimuth offline via postal code
East/West hemisphere lock and seasonal winter sun scaling
Automatically switches GNOME background and Light/Dark theme
Currently optimized for the GNOME desktop (support for KDE Plasma planned)

description.p: Initial public beta release (0.1.0) with GNOME support, offline solar calculation, seasonal scaling, and autostart daemon.
